Definition: the same as G4719; Stachys, a Christian:--Stachys.
BiblicalUsage: Stachys is named once, in Paul's greetings to Rome: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved. Paul calls him beloved, and that is all Scripture tells us of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a man can be remembered for one word from the apostle, and beloved is a good word to be remembered by.
